note: Nepal: Indians move freely (the 1950 treaty); SAARC nationals but Afghans get a free 30-day visa on arrival, Chinese, Hong Kong and Macao tourists a free one; everyone else a visa on arrival (or online beforehand) for 15, 30 or 90 days at USD 30, 50 or 125 (the longest taken; the fee isn't modelled). Nationals of Afghanistan, Cameroon, Eswatini, Ethiopia, Ghana, Iran, Iraq, Liberia, Nigeria, Palestine, Somalia, Syria and Zimbabwe need a visa from a Nepalese mission. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Nepal
sources.said: Indian citizens do not require a visa to enter Nepal. ... Foreign citizens may obtain a visa on arrival which is good for multiple entries and allows visitor to stay for no more than 15, 30 or 90 days. ... Costs (in US dollars ) as of May 2026 are: 15 day maximum: $30 30 day maximum: $50 90 day maximum: $125. ... Citizens of South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) member states (except Afghanistan ) may obtain a free visa on arrival for 30 days: Bangladesh Bhutan Maldives Pakistan Sri Lanka Citizens of the following countries and territories may obtain a free visa on arrival if they are travelling as tourists: China Hong Kong Macao ... Citizens of the following countries and territories must apply for a visa at the Nepalese diplomatic missions : Afghanistan Cameroon Eswatini Ethiopia Ghana Iran Iraq Liberia Nigeria Palestine Somalia Syria Zimbabwe
